title.en: The Sun, Earth and Moon (additional, not in the textbook)
Why does the Moon change shape?

text.en:
Tara watched the Moon every night for a week. On Monday it was a thin curve. By Sunday it was almost round.
"Is someone cutting the Moon?" she asked her uncle.
"No," he smiled. "The Moon is always round. We see more or less of its lit half as it moves around the Earth."

The Sun is a star. It gives us light and heat. The Earth and the Moon do not make their own light.
The Earth spins on its axis once in about 24 hours. This is rotation. It gives us day and night.
The Earth moves around the Sun once in about 365 days. This is revolution. One revolution is one year.
The Moon moves around the Earth once in about 27 days. The Moon shines because it reflects sunlight.
We see different amounts of the lit half of the Moon on different days. These are the phases of the Moon, from new moon to full moon.
The Sun is a star. It gives light and heat. The Moon only reflects sunlight.
The Earth spins on its axis once in about twenty-four hours. This rotation gives day and night.
The Earth goes around the Sun once in about three hundred and sixty-five days. This revolution makes a year.
The Moon goes around the Earth. We see its lit part change shape. These are the phases.

problem.en: How many days does the Earth take to go once around the Sun, and what do we call this time?

text.en: The Earth moves around the Sun. This movement is called revolution.

why.en: Going around another body is revolution.
This is the length of a year.

text.en: So the answer is about 365 days, which is one year.

prompt.en: Your younger brother asks why we have day and night. What will you tell him?

requiredIdeas.en: The Earth spins on its axis once in about 24 hours.
The side facing the Sun has day and the other side has night.

commonMisconceptions.en: Thinking the Sun moves around the Earth to make day and night.

points.en: Rotation of the Earth gives day and night.
Revolution of the Earth around the Sun takes a year.
The Moon reflects sunlight and goes around the Earth.
Phases are the changing shapes of the lit Moon.
